secondStep.notZeroHypothesisRight: H1: B{bNumber} > 0 (because b{bNumber} = {b} > 0 resulting in a right-sided test)
secondStep.notZeroHypothesisLeft: H1: B{bNumber} < 0 (because b{bNumber} = {b} < 0 resulting in a left-sided test)
secondStep.infoText: because we calculated a two-tailed p-value, to test the significance of b, we must divide the p-value by 2 and compare it with alpha, and to determine the direction of the relationship (positive or negative) we look at the sign of b.
secondStep.pValueText: We compare the pValue with the significance level α =
secondStep.significantTrue: Reject H0: B{bNumber} ≠ 0 is supported at α = {level}.
secondStep.significantFalse: Fail to reject H0: no sufficient evidence that B{bNumber} ≠ 0 at α = {level}.
secondStep.significantMultipleTrue: Reject H0 at α = {level}: the {variablesNumber} variables ({variableNames}) jointly influence {yName}.
secondStep.significantMultipleFalse: Fail to reject H0 at α = {level}: insufficient evidence of joint significance.
secondStep.conclusionSignificant: At α = {alpha}, we reject H0: {xName} has a statistically significant effect on {yName} (p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionNotSignificant: At α = {alpha}, we fail to reject H0: no sufficient evidence that {xName} influences {yName} (p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMarginal: At α = {alpha}, H0 is not rejected (p = {pValue}), but the result is borderline. Interpret with caution — consider collecting more data before drawing conclusions about {xName} → {yName}.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalHigh: The evidence is strong: significant at all conventional levels (0.01, 0.05, 0.10).
secondStep.conclusionConventionalMod: The evidence is moderate: significant at 0.05 and 0.10, but not at 0.01.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalMarg: The evidence is weak: significant only at the 0.10 level, not at 0.05 or 0.01.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalNone: The evidence is absent at all conventional levels (0.01, 0.05, 0.10).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleSignificant: At α = {alpha}, we reject H0: the model ({variableNames}) has a statistically significant overall effect on {yName} (F-p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleNotSignificant: At α = {alpha}, we fail to reject H0: insufficient evidence that ({variableNames}) collectively influence {yName} (F-p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleMarginal: At α = {alpha}, H0 is not rejected (F-p = {pValue}), but the model is borderline. Interpret with caution — consider collecting more data or reviewing the model specification.

thirdStep.interpretationVariable: If {xName} increases by {xUnit}, {yName} increases, on average, by
thirdStep.interpretationVariableDecrease: If {xName} increases by {xUnit}, {yName} decreases, on average, by
thirdStep.interpretationVariableDummy: Compared to the reference category ({xName} = 0), category {xName} = 1 increases {yName}, on average, by
thirdStep.interpretationVariableDummyDecrease: Compared to the reference category ({xName} = 0), category {xName} = 1 decreases {yName}, on average, by
thirdStep.interpretationR2Adjusted: of the variation in {yName} is explained by the variation in the set of {variableNames}
thirdStep.ciSentence: With {confidence}% confidence, the true effect lies between {lower} and {upper} {yUnit}

summaryOutput.executiveSummarySignificant: The model is statistically significant, with {power} predictive power, explaining {pct}% of the dependent variable's variation.
summaryOutput.executiveSummaryNotSignificant: The model is not statistically significant (F p-value = {pValue}), and cannot be used for reliable predictions.
summaryOutput.executiveSummaryStrongestPredictor: Based on standardized coefficients, {name} is the most influential predictor.
summaryOutput.executiveSummaryMulticollinearity: However, individual estimates should be treated with caution due to severe multicollinearity (VIF > 5) detected among predictors.
summaryOutput.multicollinearityWarning: Warning: at least one VIF > 5 — multicollinearity detected.
summaryOutput.multicollinearityEffect: This may affect the individual significance of the coefficients.

secondStep.notZeroHypothesisRight: H1: B{bNumber} > 0 (deoarece b{bNumber} = {b} > 0 deci rezultă un test unilateral la dreapta)

secondStep.infoText: deoarece am calculat p-value bilateral, pentru a testa semnificația lui b, trebuie să împărțim p-value la 2 și să comparăm cu alpha, iar pentru a stabili direcția relației (pozitivă sau negativă) ne uităm la semnul lui b.
secondStep.pValueText: Comparăm pValue cu nivelul de semnificație α =
secondStep.significantTrue: Respingem H0: B{bNumber} ≠ 0 este susținut la α = {level}.
secondStep.significantFalse: Nu respingem H0: dovezi insuficiente că B{bNumber} ≠ 0 la α = {level}.
secondStep.multipleVariableSignificance: Semnificația în raport cu ansamblul variabilelor:
secondStep.significantMultipleTrue: Respingem H0 la α = {level}: cele {variablesNumber} variabile ({variableNames}) influențează împreună {yName}.
secondStep.significantMultipleFalse: Nu respingem H0 la α = {level}: dovezi insuficiente de semnificație colectivă.
secondStep.conclusionSignificant: La α = {alpha}, respingem H0: {xName} are un efect statistic semnificativ asupra lui {yName} (p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionNotSignificant: La α = {alpha}, nu respingem H0: dovezi insuficiente că {xName} influențează {yName} (p = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMarginal: La α = {alpha}, H0 nu este respinsă (p = {pValue}), dar rezultatul este la limită. Interpretați cu prudență — luați în considerare colectarea mai multor date înainte de a trage concluzii despre {xName} → {yName}.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalHigh: Evidența este puternică: semnificativ la toate nivelurile convenționale (0,01; 0,05; 0,10).
secondStep.conclusionConventionalMod: Evidența este moderată: semnificativ la 0,05 şi 0,10, dar nu la 0,01.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalMarg: Evidența este slabă: semnificativ doar la nivelul 0,10, nu la 0,05 sau 0,01.
secondStep.conclusionConventionalNone: Nicio evidență la niciun nivel convențional (0,01; 0,05; 0,10).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleSignificant: La α = {alpha}, respingem H0: modelul ({variableNames}) are un efect global statistic semnificativ asupra lui {yName} (pValue = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleNotSignificant: La α = {alpha}, nu respingem H0: dovezi insuficiente că ({variableNames}) influențează colectiv {yName} (pValue = {pValue}).
secondStep.conclusionMultipleMarginal: La α = {alpha}, H0 nu este respinsă (F-p = {pValue}), dar modelul este la limită. Interpretați cu prudență — luați în considerare colectarea mai multor date sau revizuirea specificației modelului.
